conserje-48.idle: La animación de reposo del juego NO es de PixelLab: la hace tools/idle.py a partir de las rotaciones (respiración de 1 píxel y parpadeo, 20 fotogramas a 5 por segundo). Se probaron tres de PixelLab el 2026-10-12 y se descartaron: 'idle' (plantilla breathing-idle, 8 direcciones, grupo 39d7ad63-7fa9-4190-b55f-2d425c3764b2: respira bien pero redibuja la cara en cada fotograma), 'idle-estable' (skeleton-v3, solo sur, grupo 4b4896ea-7b4b-444f-bcdb-b419b58b7d23: cambia el pelo) e 'idle-v3' (a medida, solo sur, grupo b4151f71-018d-47a5-8eaa-c968bbf30f60: cambia la cara y la estatura). Coste: 10 generaciones. Las dos últimas y las tres pruebas de andar se borraron de PixelLab el 2026-10-12; allí quedan solo idle (plantilla) y andar.
conserje-48.idle_pixminimax: Prueba del 2026-10-12, sin usar en el juego: modo pixminimax, solo sur, 8 fotogramas, con el dibujo quieto también como fotograma final para que cierre el ciclo. Grupo 304aff70-2123-4336-8349-12043852e825, 1 generación. Texto: 'standing still and breathing calmly: the chest gently rises and falls, the shoulders lift very slightly, one slow blink; feet stay planted, head stays steady, arms stay relaxed at the sides, then back to the starting pose'. Resultado: conserva la cara, la anchura y la estatura mucho mejor que la plantilla y que v3; fallos: tiene los ojos cerrados en 4 de los 8 fotogramas y el último no llega a ser igual que el primero.

ataque_pruebas.action_description: Stepping forward with the lead foot, he heaves the mop up over his head with both hands, then twists his torso and shoulders and swings it straight down in front of him in one hard, fast vertical overhead arc. The wet grey mop head slams flat onto the floor ahead of his feet; the string strands whip and trail behind the swing, then splay out on impact, flinging a few small water droplets. His knees bend and his back leans into the blow, the tail of the red bandana flicking with the motion. He absorbs the impact, pulls the mop back up and settles cleanly into the starting guard stance. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.

east.subject_description: a young male janitor with brown hair and a red bandana, cream shirt and blue work overalls, holding a black 9mm pistol with both hands
east.initial_pose: standing in a two-handed shooting stance facing right, both arms extended forward, aiming the pistol to the right
east.action_description: He fires one single shot with the pistol. The gun kicks back with a sharp recoil: his hands and forearms jerk up a little and his shoulders rock back, while his feet stay planted and he keeps aiming in exactly the same direction. A bright yellow and orange muzzle flash bursts out of the barrel of the pistol for an instant, then a small puff of light grey smoke drifts from the muzzle and a tiny brass casing flips out of the side of the gun. The flash and the smoke fade away quickly, he brings the pistol back down level and settles cleanly into the starting two-handed aiming stance. Only one shot, no second flash. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.

ataque.action_description: He attacks with a savage two-handed claw swipe. He jerks both arms up and back, then lunges forward with one heavy step and slashes both clawed hands forward and down in front of him at chest height, his jaw snapping open as his head thrusts forward. His body leans far into the lunge and his hair shakes with the motion. He keeps facing exactly the same direction the whole time. Then he pulls back, his arms drop limp again and he settles cleanly into the starting hunched stance. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.

golpe.resultado: se echa atrás y vuelve; salpicón grande de sangre y mancha roja que se queda en el pecho
golpe.action_description: He takes a hard hit to the chest from the front. His head and shoulders snap backward, his torso bends back and his arms fling loosely forward, and he staggers one short step backward, off balance. His hair jolts with the impact. He keeps facing exactly the same direction the whole time and stays on his feet. Then he sways forward again, his arms drop limp and he settles cleanly into the starting hunched stance. No blood, no effects. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.

muerte.resultado: cae de espaldas y se queda tendido; chorro grande de sangre
muerte.action_description: He is killed and collapses. His head snaps back from a final blow, his knees buckle and his whole body goes limp. He topples backward and falls flat onto the floor on his back, arms flopping out to the sides, legs sprawled, and he bounces very slightly as he lands. Then he lies completely still and motionless on the ground for the last frames, dead, flat on his back. He never gets up. No blood pool, no effects. Static camera, completely locked-off shot. Maintain the crisp 2D pixel art aesthetic, thick dark outlines, flat colors, the same character size and the strict original low top-down perspective throughout the entire fluid animation.

escenario-bano.nota: Piloto del tono nuevo del escenario (oscuro, sucio, con sangre; decidido por el dueño el 2026-10-13 a partir de una imagen de referencia de un baño). Piezas sueltas con create_image_pixflux, 1 generación cada una, en assets/sources/escenario-bano/. Maqueta (antes y después): py tools/maqueta_bano.py -> assets/pruebas/bano-maqueta.png. Aún NO está en el juego. Receta: muebles con 'front view facing the viewer, 3/4 top-down RPG perspective, game furniture sprite, horror game, muted colors', outline negro, highly detailed; cosas de pared con view side y 'seen straight from the front, wall mounted'; manchas del suelo lineless y 'seen from directly above, game decal sprite'.
escenario-bano.coste: 22 generaciones (16 de la primera tanda, 6 de repetir)
